description: Infant weighing-scale photos from the KMC programme. A visit's photo is compared against the weight the worker typed for that same visit.

measurement.note: A visit is eligible for a photo only if it recorded a weight. The manifest author supplies the form paths; this corpus supplies the values.

digital.note: Rejects a reading 5 g off. Verified on a 10-image control at +/-5, +/-10, +/-100 g: 0 false accepts.

dial.note: Accepts a RANGE. A value meant to fail review must fall outside match_band_grams, not merely differ from reading_grams. See #1563.

ground_truth.method: vision read, then confirmed against the production classifier; recorded only where it returned match=true
ground_truth.scope: Covers the good pool's READINGS only. Those are machine-confirmed per file, so a file/value misalignment cannot survive. Bad-pool category and scale_type are human judgement with no such check — an earlier set of them was shifted by one and wrong; they were re-derived from filename-stamped images and are inspectable in the review sheet.

good.meaning: readable photo with a confirmed reading; use for visits that should PASS review

bad.meaning: photo defect; carries no reading. Use for visits that should FAIL on the PHOTO. Categorised in images[].category.

trajectories.note: Real per-infant weight series, in visit order. Either weight-MATCH against a cohort's own curve, or REPLAY a trajectory onto a synthetic infant. buckets: normal_gain (10), slow_gain (10).

kmc-scale_bad_001.jpg.reason: Salter/UNICEF dial shot off-axis; the needle body lies across the arc it indexes, so the indicated value shifts with viewing angle.
kmc-scale_bad_001.jpg.metadata_source: human read of a filename-stamped image

kmc-scale_bad_002.jpg.reason: Digital LCD readable only because it is backlit — the surrounding frame is black, so nothing corroborates the reading.
kmc-scale_bad_002.jpg.metadata_source: human read of a filename-stamped image

kmc-scale_bad_003.jpg.reason: Salter/UNICEF dial cropped to the 0-4 kg arc with the needle at the very edge of frame; the pivot and the rest of the face are outside the photo.
kmc-scale_bad_003.jpg.metadata_source: human read of a filename-stamped image

kmc-scale_bad_004.jpg.reason: Digital scale photographed with the LCD dark — the segment digits are not resolvable at all.
kmc-scale_bad_004.jpg.metadata_source: human read of a filename-stamped image

kmc-scale_bad_005.jpg.reason: Salter 235 6S dial shot in the dark with flash; grain and the pivot shadow obscure where the needle meets the graduations.
kmc-scale_bad_005.jpg.metadata_source: human read of a filename-stamped image

kmc-scale_bad_006.jpg.reason: Salter/UNICEF dial from above and to the side; the needle occludes the arc beneath it.
kmc-scale_bad_006.jpg.metadata_source: human read of a filename-stamped image

kmc-scale_bad_007.jpg.reason: Salter/UNICEF dial with a specular highlight across the face, erasing the graduations either side of the needle.
kmc-scale_bad_007.jpg.metadata_source: human read of a filename-stamped image

kmc-scale_bad_008.jpg.reason: Salter/UNICEF dial under heavy blur — the graduations are soft and no tick can be resolved against the needle.
kmc-scale_bad_008.jpg.metadata_source: human read of a filename-stamped image

kmc-scale_bad_009.jpg.reason: YRBB-20 pan scale photographed from standing height; the dial occupies a small fraction of the frame and the red needle subtends only a few pixels.
kmc-scale_bad_009.jpg.metadata_source: human read of a filename-stamped image

kmc-scale_bad_010.jpg.reason: Digital scale, extreme blur plus a specular blowout over the LCD — the display is a smear.
kmc-scale_bad_010.jpg.metadata_source: human read of a filename-stamped image

provenance.source_structure: Normal Weight Gain Images / Slow Weight Gain Images, each holding 10 per-infant folders (SVN 1..10) of '<child name> Visit-N.jpg'; plus Good/Bad Quality Images. Child names were PII and are NOT carried forward — 'subject' is a synthetic label and 'visit_seq' preserves the ordering the filenames encoded.
provenance.privacy: Source filenames carried real infant names; dropped. subject/visit_seq preserve only their ordering.
